verdict.rationale: Kushki is a hosted payment gateway. Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since some payment orchestration products are self-hostable, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosted, on-premise or open-source deployment of the core product: the docs cover hosted card payments, Webpay, 3DS, POS and the hosted docs index (llms.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
